questions.stem: A and B invest Rs.4,000 and Rs.6,000 in a business. Annual profit = Rs.5,000. Find A's share.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A and B invest Rs.3,000 and Rs.5,000 for equal duration. Find the ratio of their profits.
questions.explanation:
When time is equal, profit ratio = investment ratio.
Ratio = 3000 : 5000 = 3 : 5
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A, B, C invest Rs.2,000, Rs.3,000, Rs.5,000 for 1 year. Total profit = Rs.2,000. Find A's share.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A invests 2/5 of the total capital for 1/3 of the year. B invests the remaining capital for the remaining period. Find the ratio of A's to B's profit.
questions.explanation:
Effective capital-time for A = (2/5) × (1/3) = 2/15
Effective capital-time for B = (3/5) × (2/3) = 6/15
Ratio = 2/15 : 6/15 = 2 : 6 = 1 : 3
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A invests Rs.5,000 for 2 years. B invests Rs.4,000 for 3 years. Find the ratio of their profits.
questions.explanation:
Profit ratio = Investment × Time
A = 5000 × 2 = 10,000
B = 4000 × 3 = 12,000
Ratio = 10,000 : 12,000 = 5 : 6
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A invests Rs.6,000 and B invests Rs.12,000. If total profit = Rs.4,500, find B's profit.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A and B invest in ratio 3:5. Total profit = Rs.640. Find A's profit.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A, B, C invest Rs.3,600, Rs.4,800, Rs.2,400 for 1 year. Total profit = Rs.4,500. Find C's share.
questions.explanation:
Simplify ratio: 3600 : 4800 : 2400 = 3 : 4 : 2
Total parts = 3+4+2 = 9
C's share = 2/9 × 4500 = Rs.1,000
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A invests Rs.10,000 for 8 months, B invests Rs.12,000 for 6 months. Find ratio of profits.
questions.explanation:
A's effective capital = 10000 × 8 = 80,000
B's effective capital = 12000 × 6 = 72,000
Ratio = 80,000 : 72,000 = 10 : 9
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A starts a business with Rs.8,000. After 4 months, B joins with Rs.6,000. At year end, total profit = Rs.9,000. Find B's share.
questions.explanation:
A = 8000 × 12 = 96,000 (invested for full year)
B = 6000 × 8 = 48,000 (joined after 4 months → 8 months remaining)
Ratio = 96,000 : 48,000 = 2 : 1
B's share = 1/3 × 9000 = Rs.3,000
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A, B, C invest Rs.1,200 for 6 months, Rs.1,400 for 8 months, Rs.1,600 for 10 months respectively. Find their profit ratio.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A and B are partners. Total profit = Rs.7,500. A is the working partner and gets 20% of profit as salary first. Remaining is shared in 3:2. Find A's total earnings.
questions.explanation:
A's salary = 20% × 7500 = Rs.1,500
Remaining profit = 7500 − 1500 = Rs.6,000
A's capital share = 3/5 × 6000 = Rs.3,600
A's total = 1500 + 3600 = Rs.5,100
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A invests Rs.5P for 6 months, B invests Rs.3P for 8 months. Find their profit ratio.
questions.explanation:
A's effective capital = 5P × 6 = 30P
B's effective capital = 3P × 8 = 24P
Ratio = 30P : 24P = 5 : 4

questions.stem: A starts a business with Rs.9,000. After 3 months, B joins. At year end, profits are shared equally. How much did B invest?
questions.explanation:
For equal profit shares: A's (capital × time) = B's (capital × time)
A invests for 12 months: 9000 × 12 = 1,08,000
B invests for 9 months (joins after 3): B × 9 = 1,08,000
B = 1,08,000 ÷ 9 = Rs.12,000

questions.stem: A, B, C are partners with capitals Rs.20,000, Rs.25,000, Rs.30,000. A manages the business and gets Rs.1,000/month as salary. Annual profit before salary = Rs.24,000. Find B's share of the remaining profit.
questions.explanation:
A's management salary = 1000 × 12 = Rs.12,000
Profit for distribution = 24,000 − 12,000 = Rs.12,000
Capital ratio = 20,000 : 25,000 : 30,000 = 4 : 5 : 6
Total parts = 15
B's share = 5/15 × 12,000 = Rs.4,000

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A, B, C invest in ratio 3:4:5. A invests for 4 months, B for 6 months, C for 8 months. Total profit = Rs.5,700. Find C's share.
questions.explanation:
Effective capital-time:
A = 3 × 4 = 12
B = 4 × 6 = 24
C = 5 × 8 = 40
Total = 12 + 24 + 40 = 76
C's share = 40/76 × 5700 = 40 × 75 = Rs.3,000

**Short Trick:** Per-unit profit = 5700/76 = 75. C = 40 × 75 = Rs.3,000.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.stem: A started a business with Rs.6,000. B joined after 2 months with Rs.8,000. C joined after 4 months with Rs.10,000. End-of-year profit = Rs.11,600. Find B's share.
questions.explanation:
A = 6000 × 12 = 72,000
B = 8000 × 10 = 80,000 (joined after 2 months)
C = 10000 × 8 = 80,000 (joined after 4 months)
Ratio = 72 : 80 : 80 = 9 : 10 : 10
Total parts = 29
Per-unit profit = 11,600 / 29 = 400
B's share = 10 × 400 = Rs.4,000

**Short Trick:** Per-unit = Total/sum of parts. B = 10 × (11600/29) = Rs.4,000.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
